note: Phase E2 cables. Units m, rest = hand.glb geometry. Sample i of a cable is carried by bones j[i] with weights w[i] (indices into joints, same as the glTF skin). Twist joint k = rotation about the forearm axis by twist x (pronation - rest). Tendon: insertion end (last sample) fixed, constant length from the insertion, muscle-tendon junction at u_mtj; belly moves f x excursion, radius x 1/sqrt(axial scale). Nerves/vessels: both ends fixed; slack shows as a wave (wavelength glide.wave_m), when taut they glide (uniform strain). E2b zones[k] = {child, parent, i0, i1, dofs}: samples i0..i1 between the zone ends i0-1 and i1+1 are posed in polar coordinates about arc_joints[child].center (axis = parent->child rotation axis, parent frame): each keeps its distance from the axis and takes the ends' changes of angle, radius and axial position in proportion to its rest angle between them (tisspose.zone). Tendon mechanics: mech[dof] = excursion table F (m) from deg0 in steps of step deg = integral of the ARMS moment arm (tools/arms_ma.json, scaled by mech_scale); a zone's material slides by sum F (dofs), the rest of the difference to the visual path is taken up in the zone. Zones without dofs (CMC1) use the visual path.
